dct_title_s: Cultural Features - Dikes, Dams, Great Wall (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point and line layer describes man-made cultural features, specifically dikes, dams and the Great Wall of China.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, environmental monitoring, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on cultural resource assessment and management and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
Supplemental information: Dam lines coincident with the outline of reservoirs were treated as vector lines. The reservoir is on the left of the lines direction.
